name: Lyo.Note
tagline: Contracts for notes hung on entities. A note has a **subject** (what it is about) and an **actor** (who wrote it), both as `EntityRef`.
description: Contracts for notes hung on entities. A note has a **subject** (what it is about) and an **actor** (who wrote it), both as `EntityRef`. The default Postgres store maps `for_entity_*` / `from_entity_*` (nullable varchar) and uses soft-delete.

sections.title: `INoteStore`
items: `SaveAsync(NoteRecord note, CancellationToken ct = default)` insert or update. If `note.Id` matches an active row, that row's subject/actor endpoints and `Content` are updated in place. Otherwise a new row is inserted. A new `Id` is generated when `Id == default`.
`GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)` one note by id. Active rows only.
`GetForEntityAsync(EntityRef forEntity, CancellationToken ct = default)` every note on that target, ordered by `CreatedAt`.
`GetFromEntityAsync(EntityRef fromEntity, CancellationToken ct = default)` every note written by that actor, ordered by `CreatedAt`.
`GetForEntityTypeAsync(string forEntityType, Guid? forEntityId = null, CancellationToken ct = default)` every note for a target *type*. Optionally restrict to one target id.
`DeleteAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)` soft-delete one note.
`DeleteForEntityAsync(EntityRef forEntity, CancellationToken ct = default)` soft-delete every note on that target.

sections.title: `NoteRecord`
items: `Content`. Note body. A string, and it may be empty.
